audit.why: 52.37% over 697 games fits EVEN / 6-10; Olaf owns 1-3, it levels 4-6, Singed takes two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 said Olaf and 2+ items said Olaf in both layers; the packet chart says Skill and Singed, and the mirror already flipped exactly these two rows from the other side.
audit.why: Level 6 is not Olaf's window here — Ragnarok does not answer Fling — and Singed plainly owns the two-item mark.
audit.corrected: phases[4]/[6].side and win[4]/[6] flipped in matched pairs, ratings moved to follow, both phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Fling his W in eight places (Fling is E, 125 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s; W is Mega Adhesive), and claimed Ragnarok 'cleanses' the fling.
audit.why: Fling carries the knockup flag, whose own note reads 'displacement — ignored by unstoppable'. So Ragnarok's disable immunity does NOT stop Fling: the page told the reader to hold their ultimate for the one thing it cannot answer. The other unstated interaction is Riot's own Fling text — a target flung into Mega Adhesive is ROOTED, not just slowed. And Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which cuts the lifesteal Berserker Rage gives Olaf as he drops low.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected throughout, the Ragnarok-stops-Fling claim removed everywhere, the fling-into-adhesive root stated, and the Grievous Wounds interaction written into mid, late and the level-6 why.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] told the reader to rush Executioner's Calling because 'his healing fights your pattern'.
audit.why: Singed has no heal anywhere in his kit — Noxious Slipstream is a move-speed burst. The healing pressure runs the other way: his ultimate anti-heals Olaf.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal line removed from itemization and from breakdown.late.

edits.before: Singed is one of the few champs who can just walk away from your Q-slow because his base move speed and W goo are so high, so do not throw axes into open ground he can sidestep. Aim Q to land directly on him when he steps up to last-hit, then walk in and stack autos plus an E true-damage tick while your passive attack speed ramps. He has no real early damage besides poison tick, so a clean Q-into-E trade chunks him hard before he can fling you. Watch for him proxying behind your tower instead of fighting.
edits.after: Singed is one of the few champs who can just walk away from your Q-slow, because Noxious Slipstream gives him a speed burst every time he passes you, so do not throw axes into open ground he can sidestep. Aim Q to land directly on him when he steps up to last-hit, then walk in and stack autos plus an E true-damage tick while your passive attack speed ramps. He has no early damage besides Poison Trail, so a clean Q-into-E trade chunks him hard before he can Fling you. Watch for him proxying behind your tower instead of fighting.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you still out-trade him, but his W fling becomes the whole fight: if he flings you back into his poison trail you eat unavoidable damage and he kites away on goo speed, so trade only when his W is on cooldown. At 6 your Ragnarok cleanses that fling AND ignores his ground-slow, which is your single best dive window, but he heals so much from his passive sustain that you may not convert a kill without jungle help. This lane tilts toward who controls the wave: if he proxies, deny it and freeze to force him to walk into your Q.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you still out-trade him, but Fling becomes the whole fight: at 125 range on 10s it throws you behind him, and if he has dropped Mega Adhesive where you land you are rooted in the poison, so trade only when Fling is down. At 6, Ragnarok lets you keep swinging through his CC — but Fling is a displacement it does not stop, and Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which cuts the lifesteal Berserker Rage gives you. This lane tilts toward who controls the wave: if he proxies, deny it and freeze to force him to walk into your Q.

edits.before: This is where Singed takes over. Once he has Rylai's, Liandry's and Demonic Embrace, his W-fling plus the permanent slow goo means your flat E true damage and short trades stop mattering, and his move speed lets him run you down or simply walk away whenever he wants. You cannot catch a Singed who does not want to be caught, and his sustain out-heals your W omnivamp by full build. Your only path is to have already converted the early lead into towers, plates and objectives before he comes online, then group rather than try to 1v1 him.
edits.after: This is where Singed takes over. Once he has Rylai's, Liandry's and Demonic Embrace, Fling plus the permanent Mega Adhesive slow means your flat E true damage and short trades stop mattering, and Noxious Slipstream lets him run you down or simply walk away whenever he wants. You cannot catch a Singed who does not want to be caught, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds cuts your lifesteal in every extended fight. Your only path is to have already converted the early lead into towers, plates and objectives before he comes online, then group rather than try to 1v1 him.
